bottom_30_families_by_distance_matched_a.description: Pseudoknot of upstream pseudoknot domain (UPD) of the 3'UTR

method.distance_matched_metric: mean within-sequence percentile of every reference-pair score among non-pairs in the same power-of-two separation bin
method.interpretation_boundary: model dependency, not a demonstrated physical or molecular interaction
method.reference: Rfam consensus pairs mapped to one ungapped seed representative per family
method.score: max over 3 source substitutions and 4 target bases of absolute change in log2 odds
